Title: Azure Sphere update 20.10 is now available for compatibility testing

Body.Content:
The Azure Sphere OS update 20.10 is now available for evaluation via the Retail Eval feed. The retail evaluation period is for backwards compatibility testing. During this time, please verify that your applications and devices operate properly with this release before it's deployed broadly via the Retail feed. The Retail feed will continue to deliver OS version 20.09 until we publish the 20.10 update in early November.

The 20.10 evaluation release includes an OS update as well as a special evaluation version of the SDK for use during this period. The evaluation SDK will be replaced by the final version of the 20.10 SDK when OS is released to the retail feed.

For this release, the Retail Evaluation period will be somewhat different from previous evaluation periods. For more details about this retail evaluation release, as well as instructions for downloading and installing the evaluation SDK, please see the online documentation at 20.10 Retail Evaluation. For more information on Azure Sphere OS feeds and setting up an evaluation device group, see Azure Sphere OS feeds.

If you encounter problems:

For self-help technical inquiries, please visit Microsoft Q&A or Stack Overflow. If you require technical support and have a support plan, please submit a support ticket in Microsoft Azure Support or work with your Microsoft Technical Account Manager. If you would like to purchase a support plan, please explore the Azure support plans.
